en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of an Italian piazza featuring a large baroque fountain topped by a statue of Neptune, surrounded by mythological figures. Behind it stands a richly frescoed Renaissance building with arched porticoes at street level and shuttered windows above, alongside a domed church. The handwritten caption along the bottom identifies the scene and has a scalloped postcard border.
